method: Approximate physical nonblank noncomment theorem-body lines after the top-level :=, including by and tactic scaffolding. Only experiment datatype-specific theorem declarations reachable from each final bundle are included. Generic framework theorems, definitions, theorem statements, unused experiments, production helper proofs and sequential bridges are excluded. Full dependency totals share proof code and must not be summed. README marginal estimates assign shared family proofs once; abbrev specializations cost one binding line.
